name: Ibn Munadhir
bio: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Munadhir grew up in Basra. Accounts differ on whether his family came from Aden or Basra itself. He studied law, hadith and language, praised the Barmakids and became known for his satires and his elegies for Abd al-Majid ibn Abd al-Wahhab al-Thaqafi. Ibn al-Mu'tazz tells of a visitor who found grammarians and transmitters of poetry in the Sacred Mosque at Mecca writing down his words. Al-Zirikli dates his death there to 198 AH (813 CE).
